 Under Secretary for Public Diplomacy and Public Affairs > Bureau of Public Affairs > Bureau of Public Affairs: Press Relations Office > Press Releases (Other) > Press Releases: 2009 > Press Releases: April 2009
Office of the Special Envoy for Eurasian Energy (S/EEE)

Robert Wood
Acting Department Spokesman,  Office of the Spokesman
Bureau of Public Affairs
Washington, DC
April 20, 2009

The Secretary has appointed Ambassador Richard L. Morningstar as Special Envoy for Eurasian Energy.

Ambassador Morningstar and his staff will support the United States’ energy goals in the Eurasian region. He will work on key energy issues relating to Europe, Russia, Ukraine, Turkey, Central Asia and the Caucasus. He will provide the Secretary with strategic advice on policy issues relating to development, transit, and distribution of energy resources in Eurasia.



PRN: 2009/350
